The petitioner is seeking regular bail in FIR No.355 dated 21.07.2022 under Sections 201, 409, 420,
467, 468, 471 IPC and Sections 7 and 13(2) of the Prevention of Corruption Act, registered at Police Station Model Town, District Rewari.

2. Learned Senior counsel for the petitioner, inter alia, submits that the petitioner has returned the substantial part of the total amount which was alleged to have been withdrawn from the account of Haryana State Vikas Pradhikaran where he was working as a Data Entry Operator (Clerk).
He further submits that the amount had been withdrawn after due authorization by the higher officials which include Accountant Suraj Bhan and the Estate Officer Vijay Kumar.
The OTP had been verified by these officials and only thereafter the petitioner had operated the account.
He also submits that the petitioner is not involved in any other case.
He is in custody for over a year and the conclusion of the trial is likely to take sometime.

sentences.text:
Learned State counsel submits that the petitioner had withdrawn a sum of Rs.1,76,43,159/-
approximately which is alleged to have been misappropriated by the petitioner, he has returned an amount of Rs.90 lacs and an amount of Rs.86 lacs is still outstanding.
He has filed the custody certificate in Court which indicates that the petitioner is in custody for 01 year and 18 days months as on 17.08.2023.
He, upon instructions from ASI Dharamvir, submits that 01 out of 65 prosecution witnesses has been examined.
4. Heard.

In view of the above especially when the petitioner is in custody for over a year and the conclusion of the trial is likely to take some time, I deem it a fit case to grant the concession of regular bail to the petitioner.
5. Therefore, without expressing any opinion on the merits of the case, the instant petition is allowed.
The petitioner is ordered to be released on regular bail on his furnishing requisite bonds to the satisfaction of the trial Court/Duty Magistrate concerned.
(ANUPINDER SINGH GREWAL) JUDGE August 18, 2023 sonia guenani
